question_types.name: Speaker Sex Identification
question_types.goal: Determine the speaker's sex from the voice.
question_types.answer_rule: the gender of the speaker voice

question_types.name: Regional Accent Classification
question_types.goal: Classify the regional accent heard in the recording.
question_types.answer_rule: the region label of the dialect voice

question_types.name: Voice Transcription
question_types.goal: Write down what is spoken in the clip.

question_types.name: Same Speaker Detection
question_types.goal: Detect whether two clips share one speaker.

question_types.name: Province Identification
question_types.goal: Identify the province-level dialect of the speaker.
question_types.answer_rule: the province label of the speaker

question_types.name: Same-Dialect Verification
question_types.goal: Decide whether two clips share one dialect region.
question_types.answer_rule: the same region for both clips

question_types.name: Broad Region from Province Cues
question_types.goal: Infer the broad region using province cues in the voice.
question_types.answer_rule: the region for the province heard

question_types.name: Partial Transcription
question_types.goal: Transcribe the second half of the audio.
